title: Mouse genes with lipid-related knockout phenotypes
bodyHtml:
Mouse knock-out lipid phenotypes

Human gene symbols (9,557 unique genes) were mapped to gene identifiers (HGNC) and their corresponding mouse ortholog genes were obtained using Ensembl. Phenotype data for single-gene knock-out mouse models were obtained from the International Mouse Phenotyping Consortium (IMPC) latest data release 12.0. The knock-out mouse models were primarily produced by IMPC but also include some models that have been reported from the relevant literature and were curated by Mouse Genome Informatics (MGI) data release 6.16. For each mouse model, reported phenotypes were grouped using the Mammalian Phenotype Ontology hierarchy into broad categories relevant to Lipids: growth and body weight (MP:0001259), lipid homeostasis (MP:0002118), cholesterol homeostasis (MP:0005278) and lipid metabolism (MP:0013245). This resulted in mapping of human genes to significant phenotypes in animals.

For each of the multi-ancestry lipids index variants, we mapped the closest gene to the knock-out mouse phenotypes and curated the set to only include mouse phenotypes strictly relating to lipid metabolism.
